When i joined university, i needed to secure a scholarship to gain entry to the institute, as my family was not well financed at that time. The scholarship was provided by the government ministry. However, i came to realise that the scholarship i received was not based merit, rather through some talks between my relatives and the scholarships officer behind the curtain (in secrecy). I also found out that my family had to offer some bribe to the officer in order to guarantee that i receive the scholarship for the degree of engineering. (1) Is that education which i received upon that scholarship unlawful to me? (2) I am currently working, is my income also unlawful due to receiving education where bribery was involoved. (3) I signed an agreement with the scholarships ministry (the government), where i would need to serve the country for the number of years i got the scholarship for i.e. 3 years, and it wasnt mentioned that i need to return that amount back to the government. I am almost completing my 3rd year of work on the country. Does it mean that i have to return the full amount of schlarship to the government of my country? 2474 views Q. miscellaneous 2359 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 62555 Country: Bangladesh Title: Internet Question: By games in the computer and income money, is it halal or haram. Is internet wifi income or rent halal or haram? Answer ID: 62555 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 80/80/SD=02/1437) (1) It is halal in itself to earn through providing lawful games in computer. But it is not suitable to adopt this method for income. Nowadays there are some games that are not lawful. Moreover computer games do not carry any physical or worldly benefits, rather they sometimes are harmful religiously. By adopting such sources of income sometimes one becomes cause of sins for others. Hence you should adopt any pure and halal method for income. (2) The rent of internet wifi is halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
